Buyer checklist

What institutional staking buyers should verify

Review supported networks, validator uptime, slashing-protection approach, custody integrations, reporting, API coverage, validator geographic distribution, insurance posture and governance participation before shortlisting.

01

Validator reliability

Uptime, monitoring, key management and incident response are central to staking risk.

02

Custody workflow

Institutions often need non-custodial or custody-integrated staking rather than retail staking flows.

03

Reporting and controls

Finance teams need reward reporting, audit trails, tax exports and operational transparency.
